after_justification: The fact-check documents that a lawsuit was filed in Manhattan Federal Court under the name "Katie Johnson" or "Jane Doe," accusing Donald Trump of raping a teenager in 1994, supported by sworn declarations from witnesses. However, a U.S. District Judge substantively dismissed this case in 2016, finding the plaintiff "failed to state a claim for relief," as reported by [Radar Online](https://radaronline.com/exclusives/2016/05/donald-trump-rape-lawsuit-dismissed/). The case was sealed and not covered by major news organizations, and Trump's attorney publicly denied the allegations. Since the dismissal occurred years before the claim's date in October 2020, and no evidence indicates the case was revived or pending at that time, the claim that Trump was actively "facing a court case" for this accusation is refuted.
